text: In the year 2147, above the silver clouds of New Yangon, one golden light pierced the neon sky. That light belonged to G.I. Ko Ko, the galaxy's clumsiest hero.
Ko Ko was not flying. He was falling. His jetpack sputtered, his boots spun, and his confused face said everything. Then he crashed straight into the Vertical Market.
Neon noodle stalls toppled. Robot cats scattered in every direction. Sorry, Ko Ko shouted. But beneath the broken signs, something strange was waiting.
A crystal sphere shimmered with impossible colors. Is this a very fancy egg? Ko Ko wondered. A whisper answered from inside his helmet: Guardian, seek the truth.
The artifact pulsed. The whole market fell silent. Somewhere above the rooftops, an unseen watcher had noticed the crystal had awakened.
Then the chrome drones attacked. Ko Ko tried to punch the first machine. He missed, punched himself, and somehow the drone exploded. He called it a secret technique.
His jetpack spun him like a golden tornado. A trail of fire painted accidental graffiti across the sky. The crowd cheered. The drones panicked. It was the strangest rescue New Yangon had ever seen.
Inside the crystal's glow, Ko Ko saw a hidden tower and a shadow waiting at its summit. A voice whispered, I know you. The mystery was much older than the city.
Dr. Zeta appeared, half machine and half memory. The Last Light is not power, she said. It is a choice. And the city began to tremble.
From the darkness, the Shadow Mech awakened. Its red eyes split the smoke. Lasers tore across the skyline, and the final battle began.
Ko Ko dodged the lasers while eating a floating snack. Then he raised the crystal and shouted, Ko Ko Power! For once, his aim was perfect.
The crystal struck the heart of darkness. A golden sunrise burst through the clouds. Broken towers healed, neon lights returned, and the shadow disappeared.
The truth was revealed. G.I. Ko Ko was the First Light, reborn every century to protect laughter and mystery. Even in darkness, a golden joke can shine. Powered by I Ko Ko.
